name: Harry Fox ~Yuki no Maou Hen~
original_name: は～りぃふぉっくす ～雪の魔王編～
source:
Mother Fox died of hunger in the snowfall. Little Fox was found and nursed by girl Mari.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1985.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
狐狸妈妈在风雪中饥寒交迫而死。小狐狸被名叫玛丽的少女发现，并得到了她的悉心照料。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1985.html]vndbreview[/url]]
